metadata.note: Saved to $TOKENFLOW_HOME/mappings/openrouter-export.json and reused on every refresh. Unmapped token fields (cache_write, reasoning) stay null, not 0. `estimated_cost` from the source is recorded as cost_basis:measured, so it is never overwritten by a price-table estimate. If this export's input column INCLUDED cached tokens, a mapping could not fix that — an adapter would be needed to subtract.
